would_return_reason: Simulated impatient-persona judgment: the prominent start button produced no visible next step, so I would leave.

issues.summary: Primary Start a workspace CTA changes only the URL fragment and leaves the landing page without a visible next step.
issues.reproduction: 1. Open http://127.0.0.1:4179/ in a fresh isolated browser with empty storage and cookies. 2. Use a 1280x800 desktop viewport. 3. Click the prominent main Start a workspace CTA once. 4. Observe /#start and the unchanged landing page, with no workspace-name form or dashboard.
issues.expected: The primary CTA opens a visible workspace-creation step where the synthetic workspace can be named.
issues.actual: URL became http://127.0.0.1:4179/#start. The same landing content and CTA remained visible with no explanation or next step. Local storage and session storage remained empty, document.cookie was empty, and no dashboard or starter task appeared. Persona stopped after the first major ambiguity.
